from langflow.custom import Component
from langflow.io import MessageTextInput, Output
from langflow.schema.message import Message


class SolaceAutomation(Component):
    display_name = "Solace Automation"
    name = "SolaceAutomation"
    description = "Run Solace workflows: export | clone | provision | replicate"
    icon = "workflow"

    inputs = [
        MessageTextInput(
            name="command",
            display_name="Command",
            info="export | clone | provision | replicate",
            value="export",
        )
    ]

    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Result", name="result", method="run")
    ]

    # ── helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _env(self, k, d=""):
        import os
        from pathlib import Path
        v = os.environ.get(k, "")
        if v:
            return v
        ef = Path("/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/langflow.env")
        if ef.exists():
            for ln in ef.read_text().splitlines():
                ln = ln.strip()
                if ln.startswith("#") or "=" not in ln:
                    continue
                kk, _, vv = ln.partition("=")
                if kk.strip() == k:
                    return vv.strip()
        return d

    def _ep_all(self, S, base, path, extra=None):
        items, pg = [], 1
        while True:
            pa = dict(extra or {})
            pa.update({"pageSize": 100, "pageNumber": pg})
            r = S.get(base + path, params=pa)
            r.raise_for_status()
            d = r.json().get("data", [])
            items.extend(d)
            if len(d) < 100:
                break
            pg += 1
        return items

    def _s_all(self, base, vpn, path, auth):
        url = f"{base}/msgVpns/{vpn}{path}"
        items, pg = [], 1
        while True:
            r = __import__("requests").get(
                url, auth=auth,
                headers={"Accept": "application/json"},
                params={"count": 100, "pageNumber": pg},
            )
            r.raise_for_status()
            b = r.json().get("data", [])
            items.extend(b)
            if len(b) < 100:
                break
            pg += 1
        return items

    def _sp(self, base, vpn, path, body, auth):
        import requests
        r = requests.post(
            f"{base}/msgVpns/{vpn}{path}", json=body, auth=auth,
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"},
        )
        if r.status_code == 400 and "ALREADY_EXISTS" in str(r.json()):
            return r.json()
        if r.status_code not in (200, 201):
            r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def _gen_pw(self, n=20):
        import secrets, string
        u = string.ascii_uppercase; l = string.ascii_lowercase
        d = string.digits; sp = "!@#$%^*-_=+?"
        a = u + l + d + sp
        p = [secrets.choice(u), secrets.choice(l), secrets.choice(d), secrets.choice(sp)]
        p += [secrets.choice(a) for _ in range(n - 4)]
        secrets.SystemRandom().shuffle(p)
        return "".join(p)

    def _sub(self, obj, s, t):
        if isinstance(obj, str):
            for a, b in [(s.upper(), t.upper()), (s.lower(), t.lower()), (s.capitalize(), t.capitalize())]:
                obj = obj.replace(a, b)
            return obj
        if isinstance(obj, dict):
            return {k: self._sub(v, s, t) for k, v in obj.items()}
        if isinstance(obj, list):
            return [self._sub(i, s, t) for i in obj]
        return obj

    def _recon(self, ev):
        try:
            lvls = ev.get("deliveryDescriptor", {}).get("address", {}).get("addressLevels", [])
            return "/".join(
                (f"{{{l['name']}}}" if l.get("addressLevelType") == "variable" else l["name"])
                for l in lvls
            )
        except Exception:
            return ""

    # ── entry point ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def run(self) -> Message:
        import logging
        logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="  %(message)s")

        raw = self.command
        cmd = (raw.text if hasattr(raw, "text") else str(raw)).strip().lower()

        dispatch = {
            "export": self._export,
            "clone": self._clone,
            "provision": self._provision,
            "replicate": self._replicate,
        }
        if cmd not in dispatch:
            result = f"Unknown command: {cmd!r}\nUse: export | clone | provision | replicate"
        else:
            try:
                result = dispatch[cmd]()
            except Exception as exc:
                import traceback
                result = f"ERROR: {exc}\n\n{traceback.format_exc()}"
        self.status = result
        msg = Message(text=result)
        return msg

    # ── export ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _export(self):
        import requests, json, logging
        from pathlib import Path
        from datetime import datetime, timezone

        log = logging.getLogger("export")
        TOKEN = self._env("SOLACE_API_TOKEN")
        SVC_ID = self._env("SOLACE_SERVICE_ID")
        COUNTRY = self._env("SOLACE_COUNTRY", "DEV").upper()
        DOM_NAME = self._env("SOLACE_DOMAIN_NAME", "")
        OUT = self._env("SOLACE_OUTPUT_PATH", f"/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/config/{COUNTRY.lower()}/service.json")
        EP_BASE = "https://api.solace.cloud/api/v2/architecture"
        CLOUD_BASE = "https://api.solace.cloud"
        if not TOKEN:
            return "ERROR: SOLACE_API_TOKEN not set"
        if not SVC_ID:
            return "ERROR: SOLACE_SERVICE_ID not set"
        H = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}
        S = requests.Session()
        S.headers.update(H)
        log.info("Fetching service %s ...", SVC_ID)
        svc = S.get(f"{CLOUD_BASE}/api/v0/services/{SVC_ID}").json().get("data", {})
        mgmt = (svc.get("managementContexts") or {}).get("clusterConfig") or {}
        sb = "https://" + mgmt.get("managementHostnames", {}).get("sempV2Config", "")
        sa = (mgmt.get("adminUsername", ""), mgmt.get("adminPassword", ""))
        vpn = svc.get("msgVpnName", "")
        log.info("  name=%s  VPN=%s", svc.get("name", ""), vpn)
        SP = {"default"}; SA = {"default"}; SU = {"default", "solace-cloud-client"}; SYS = "#"
        profiles = [{"name": p["clientProfileName"]} for p in self._s_all(sb, vpn, "/clientProfiles", sa)
                    if p["clientProfileName"] not in SP and not p["clientProfileName"].startswith(SYS)]
        acls = []
        for a in self._s_all(sb, vpn, "/aclProfiles", sa):
            nm = a["aclProfileName"]
            if nm in SA or nm.startswith(SYS):
                continue
            pub = [e.get("publishTopicException", "") for e in self._s_all(sb, vpn, f"/aclProfiles/{nm}/publishTopicExceptions", sa)]
            sub = [e.get("subscribeTopicException", "") for e in self._s_all(sb, vpn, f"/aclProfiles/{nm}/subscribeTopicExceptions", sa)]
            acls.append({"name": nm,
                         "publishDefault": a.get("publishTopicDefaultAction", "disallow"),
                         "subscribeDefault": a.get("subscribeTopicDefaultAction", "disallow"),
                         "publishExceptions": [t for t in pub if t],
                         "subscribeExceptions": [t for t in sub if t]})
        users = [{"name": u["clientUsername"], "password": "",
                  "clientProfile": u.get("clientProfileName", "default"),
                  "aclProfile": u.get("aclProfileName", "default"),
                  "enabled": u.get("enabled", True)}
                 for u in self._s_all(sb, vpn, "/clientUsernames", sa)
                 if u["clientUsername"] not in SU and not u["clientUsername"].startswith(SYS)]
        queues = []
        for q in self._s_all(sb, vpn, "/queues", sa):
            nm = q["queueName"]
            if nm.startswith(SYS):
                continue
            subs = [x.get("subscriptionTopic", "") for x in self._s_all(sb, vpn, f"/queues/{nm}/subscriptions", sa)]
            queues.append({"name": nm, "accessType": q.get("accessType", "non-exclusive"),
                           "owner": q.get("owner", ""), "subscriptions": [t for t in subs if t]})
        rdps = []
        for rdp in self._s_all(sb, vpn, "/restDeliveryPoints", sa):
            rn = rdp["restDeliveryPointName"]
            if rn.startswith(SYS):
                continue
            cons = [{"name": c.get("restConsumerName", ""), "host": c.get("remoteHost", ""),
                     "port": c.get("remotePort", 443), "tlsEnabled": c.get("tlsEnabled", True),
                     "httpMethod": c.get("httpMethod", "post")}
                    for c in self._s_all(sb, vpn, f"/restDeliveryPoints/{rn}/restConsumers", sa)]
            rb = self._s_all(sb, vpn, f"/restDeliveryPoints/{rn}/queueBindings", sa)
            rdps.append({"name": rn, "clientProfile": rdp.get("clientProfileName", "default"),
                         "enabled": rdp.get("enabled", True),
                         "postRequestTarget": rb[0].get("postRequestTarget", "/") if rb else "/",
                         "consumers": cons,
                         "queueBindings": [b.get("queueBindingName", "") for b in rb if b.get("queueBindingName")]})
        cluster = {"vpnName": vpn, "clientProfiles": profiles, "aclProfiles": acls,
                   "clientUsernames": users, "queues": queues, "restDeliveryPoints": rdps}
        domain = next((d for d in self._ep_all(S, EP_BASE, "/applicationDomains")
                       if (DOM_NAME and d["name"] == DOM_NAME) or (not DOM_NAME and COUNTRY in d["name"].upper())), None)
        if domain:
            did = domain["id"]; sv_map = {}; schemas = []
            for sc in self._ep_all(S, EP_BASE, "/schemas", {"applicationDomainId": did}):
                vs = S.get(EP_BASE + f"/schemas/{sc['id']}/versions").json().get("data", [])
                if not vs:
                    continue
                sv = vs[-1]
                try:
                    content = json.loads(sv.get("content", "{}")) if isinstance(sv.get("content"), str) else (sv.get("content") or {})
                except Exception:
                    content = {}
                schemas.append({"name": sc["name"], "type": sc.get("schemaType", "jsonSchema"),
                                 "version": sv.get("version", "1.0.0"), "description": sv.get("description", ""),
                                 "content": content})
                sv_map[sc["name"]] = sv["id"]
            ev_map = {}; events = []
            for ev_obj in self._ep_all(S, EP_BASE, "/events", {"applicationDomainId": did}):
                vs = S.get(EP_BASE + f"/events/{ev_obj['id']}/versions").json().get("data", [])
                if not vs:
                    continue
                ev = next((v for v in reversed(vs) if self._recon(v)), vs[-1])
                events.append({"name": ev_obj["name"], "version": ev.get("version", "1.0.0"),
                                "description": ev.get("description", ""), "topic": self._recon(ev),
                                "schemaRef": next((n for n, vid in sv_map.items() if vid == ev.get("schemaVersionId", "")), "")})
                ev_map[ev_obj["name"]] = ev["id"]
            apps = []
            for app_obj in self._ep_all(S, EP_BASE, "/applications", {"applicationDomainId": did}):
                vs = S.get(EP_BASE + f"/applications/{app_obj['id']}/versions").json().get("data", [])
                if not vs:
                    continue
                av = vs[-1]
                pi = av.get("declaredProducedEventVersionIds", [])
                ci = av.get("declaredConsumedEventVersionIds", [])
                apps.append({"name": app_obj["name"], "type": app_obj.get("applicationType", "standard"),
                              "version": av.get("version", "1.0.0"), "description": av.get("description", ""),
                              "produces": [n for n, vid in ev_map.items() if vid in pi],
                              "consumes": [n for n, vid in ev_map.items() if vid in ci]})
            ep = {"domainName": domain["name"], "domainDescription": domain.get("description", ""),
                  "schemas": schemas, "events": events, "applications": apps}
        else:
            ep = {"domainName": DOM_NAME or f"Domain-{COUNTRY}", "domainDescription": "", "schemas": [], "events": [], "applications": []}
        result = {"exportedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "sourceCountry": COUNTRY,
                  "environment": "exported",
                  "service": {"serviceId": SVC_ID, "name": svc.get("name", ""),
                               "datacenterId": svc.get("datacenterId", ""),
                               "serviceTypeId": svc.get("serviceTypeId", ""),
                               "serviceClassId": svc.get("serviceClassId", "")},
                  "eventPortal": ep, "clusterManagement": cluster}
        Path(OUT).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(OUT).write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
        log.info("Export complete -> %s", OUT)
        return json.dumps({"status": "ok", "output": OUT, "service": SVC_ID, "country": COUNTRY}, indent=2)

    # ── clone ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _clone(self):
        import json, copy, logging
        from pathlib import Path

        log = logging.getLogger("clone")
        SRC = self._env("SOLACE_SOURCE_CONFIG", "/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/config/dev-export/service.json")
        FROM = self._env("SOLACE_FROM_COUNTRY", "").upper()
        TO = self._env("SOLACE_TO_COUNTRY", "").upper()
        DC = self._env("SOLACE_DATACENTER", "")
        SN = self._env("SOLACE_SERVICE_NAME", "")
        OUT = self._env("SOLACE_OUTPUT_PATH", f"/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/config/{TO.lower()}/service.json")
        for v, nm in [(FROM, "SOLACE_FROM_COUNTRY"), (TO, "SOLACE_TO_COUNTRY"), (DC, "SOLACE_DATACENTER")]:
            if not v:
                return f"ERROR: {nm} not set"
        if FROM == TO:
            return f"ERROR: FROM == TO: {FROM}"
        if not Path(SRC).exists():
            return f"ERROR: {SRC} not found - run export first"
        source = json.loads(Path(SRC).read_text())
        src_c = source.get("sourceCountry", FROM).upper()
        log.info("Cloning %s -> %s", src_c, TO)
        cloned = self._sub(copy.deepcopy(source), src_c, TO)
        cloned.update({"sourceCountry": src_c, "targetCountry": TO, "environment": TO.lower()})
        sv = cloned.setdefault("service", {})
        sv["datacenterId"] = DC
        sv["serviceId"] = ""
        if SN:
            sv["name"] = SN
        cloned.setdefault("clusterManagement", {})["vpnName"] = ""
        gen = []
        for u in cloned.get("clusterManagement", {}).get("clientUsernames", []):
            if not u.get("password"):
                pw = self._gen_pw()
                u["password"] = pw
                gen.append((u["name"], pw))
        Path(OUT).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        Path(OUT).write_text(json.dumps(cloned, indent=2))
        log.info("Clone ready -> %s", OUT)
        lines = [json.dumps({"status": "ok", "output": OUT, "from": src_c, "to": TO, "passwords_generated": len(gen)}, indent=2)]
        if gen:
            lines.append("\nGenerated passwords (save these):")
            for name, pw in gen:
                lines.append(f"  {name:<35}  {pw}")
        return "\n".join(lines)

    # ── provision ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _provision(self):
        import requests, json, logging
        from pathlib import Path

        log = logging.getLogger("provision")
        TOKEN = self._env("SOLACE_API_TOKEN")
        CFG = self._env("SOLACE_CONFIG", "")
        DRY = self._env("SOLACE_DRY_RUN", "false").lower() == "true"
        EP_BASE = "https://api.solace.cloud/api/v2/architecture"
        if not TOKEN:
            return "ERROR: SOLACE_API_TOKEN not set"
        if not CFG:
            return "ERROR: SOLACE_CONFIG not set"
        if not Path(CFG).exists():
            return f"ERROR: {CFG} not found"
        cfg = json.loads(Path(CFG).read_text())
        env = cfg.get("environment", "unknown")
        log.info("Provisioning env=%s dry_run=%s", env, DRY)
        H = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}
        S = requests.Session()
        S.headers.update(H)
        ep_cfg = cfg.get("eventPortal", {})
        cl = cfg.get("clusterManagement", {})
        ep_ids = {}

        def ep_find(p, nm, did=None):
            pa = {"name": nm}
            if did:
                pa["applicationDomainId"] = did
            d = S.get(EP_BASE + p, params=pa).json().get("data", [])
            return d[0] if d else None

        def ep_post(p, body):
            r = S.post(EP_BASE + p, json=body)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.json().get("data", {})

        if not DRY:
            dom = ep_find("/applicationDomains", ep_cfg["domainName"]) or ep_post("/applicationDomains", {"name": ep_cfg["domainName"], "description": ep_cfg.get("domainDescription", "")})
            ep_ids["domainId"] = dom["id"]
            sv_map = {}
            for sc in ep_cfg.get("schemas", []):
                s = ep_find("/schemas", sc["name"], dom["id"]) or ep_post("/schemas", {"name": sc["name"], "applicationDomainId": dom["id"], "schemaType": sc.get("type", "jsonSchema")})
                vs = S.get(EP_BASE + f"/schemas/{s['id']}/versions").json().get("data", [])
                if vs:
                    sv = vs[-1]
                else:
                    c = sc.get("content", {})
                    sv = ep_post(f"/schemas/{s['id']}/versions", {"version": sc.get("version", "1.0.0"), "content": json.dumps(c) if isinstance(c, dict) else c, "description": sc.get("description", "")})
                sv_map[sc["name"]] = sv["id"]
                log.info("  schema: %s", sc["name"])
            ev_map = {}
            for ec in ep_cfg.get("events", []):
                e = ep_find("/events", ec["name"], dom["id"]) or ep_post("/events", {"name": ec["name"], "applicationDomainId": dom["id"]})
                vs = S.get(EP_BASE + f"/events/{e['id']}/versions").json().get("data", [])
                if vs:
                    ev = vs[-1]
                else:
                    svid = sv_map.get(ec.get("schemaRef", ""))
                    lvls = [{"name": p.strip("{}") if p.startswith("{") else p, "addressLevelType": "variable" if p.startswith("{") else "literal"} for p in ec.get("topic", "").split("/")]
                    b = {"version": ec.get("version", "1.0.0"), "deliveryDescriptor": {"brokerType": "solace", "address": {"addressLevels": lvls}}}
                    if svid:
                        b["schemaVersionId"] = svid
                    ev = ep_post(f"/events/{e['id']}/versions", b)
                ev_map[ec["name"]] = ev["id"]
                log.info("  event: %s", ec["name"])
            for ac in ep_cfg.get("applications", []):
                a = ep_find("/applications", ac["name"], dom["id"]) or ep_post("/applications", {"name": ac["name"], "applicationDomainId": dom["id"], "applicationType": ac.get("type", "standard")})
                vs = S.get(EP_BASE + f"/applications/{a['id']}/versions").json().get("data", [])
                if not vs:
                    prod = [ev_map[n] for n in ac.get("produces", []) if n in ev_map]
                    cons = [ev_map[n] for n in ac.get("consumes", []) if n in ev_map]
                    ep_post(f"/applications/{a['id']}/versions", {"version": ac.get("version", "1.0.0"), "declaredProducedEventVersionIds": prod, "declaredConsumedEventVersionIds": cons})
                log.info("  app: %s", ac["name"])
        ctx_path = Path("/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/.solace-context.json")
        ctx = json.loads(ctx_path.read_text()) if ctx_path.exists() else {}
        vpn = cl.get("vpnName", "") or ctx.get("vpnName", "")
        if not vpn:
            return "ERROR: vpnName not set"
        sb = self._env("SEMP_BASE_URL", ctx.get("sempBaseUrl", ""))
        sa = (self._env("SEMP_USERNAME", ctx.get("sempUsername", "")), self._env("SEMP_PASSWORD", ctx.get("sempPassword", "")))
        if not DRY:
            for p in cl.get("clientProfiles", []):
                self._sp(sb, vpn, "/clientProfiles", {"clientProfileName": p["name"], "msgVpnName": vpn}, sa)
                log.info("  profile: %s", p["name"])
            for a in cl.get("aclProfiles", []):
                self._sp(sb, vpn, "/aclProfiles", {"aclProfileName": a["name"], "msgVpnName": vpn, "publishTopicDefaultAction": a.get("publishDefault", "disallow"), "subscribeTopicDefaultAction": a.get("subscribeDefault", "disallow")}, sa)
                for t in a.get("publishExceptions", []):
                    self._sp(sb, vpn, f"/aclProfiles/{a['name']}/publishTopicExceptions", {"aclProfileName": a["name"], "msgVpnName": vpn, "publishTopicException": t, "publishTopicExceptionSyntax": "smf"}, sa)
                for t in a.get("subscribeExceptions", []):
                    self._sp(sb, vpn, f"/aclProfiles/{a['name']}/subscribeTopicExceptions", {"aclProfileName": a["name"], "msgVpnName": vpn, "subscribeTopicException": t, "subscribeTopicExceptionSyntax": "smf"}, sa)
                log.info("  ACL: %s", a["name"])
            for u in cl.get("clientUsernames", []):
                self._sp(sb, vpn, "/clientUsernames", {"clientUsername": u["name"], "msgVpnName": vpn, "password": u.get("password", ""), "clientProfileName": u.get("clientProfile", "default"), "aclProfileName": u.get("aclProfile", "default"), "enabled": u.get("enabled", True)}, sa)
                log.info("  user: %s", u["name"])
            for q in cl.get("queues", []):
                self._sp(sb, vpn, "/queues", {"queueName": q["name"], "msgVpnName": vpn, "accessType": q.get("accessType", "non-exclusive"), "ingressEnabled": True, "egressEnabled": True}, sa)
                for t in q.get("subscriptions", []):
                    self._sp(sb, vpn, f"/queues/{q['name']}/subscriptions", {"msgVpnName": vpn, "queueName": q["name"], "subscriptionTopic": t}, sa)
                log.info("  queue: %s", q["name"])
        log.info("Provisioning complete")
        return json.dumps({"status": "ok" if not DRY else "dry_run", "env": env, "ep_ids": ep_ids}, indent=2)

    # ── replicate ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    def _replicate(self):
        import requests, json, copy, logging
        from pathlib import Path
        from datetime import datetime, timezone

        log = logging.getLogger("replicate")
        TOKEN = self._env("SOLACE_API_TOKEN")
        SVC_ID = self._env("SOLACE_SERVICE_ID")
        FROM = self._env("SOLACE_FROM_COUNTRY", "").upper()
        TO = self._env("SOLACE_TO_COUNTRY", "").upper()
        DC = self._env("SOLACE_DATACENTER", "")
        SN = self._env("SOLACE_SERVICE_NAME", "")
        DRY = self._env("SOLACE_DRY_RUN", "false").lower() == "true"
        OUT = self._env("SOLACE_OUTPUT_PATH", f"/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/config/{TO.lower()}/service.json")
        for v, nm in [(TOKEN, "SOLACE_API_TOKEN"), (SVC_ID, "SOLACE_SERVICE_ID"), (FROM, "SOLACE_FROM_COUNTRY"), (TO, "SOLACE_TO_COUNTRY"), (DC, "SOLACE_DATACENTER")]:
            if not v:
                return f"ERROR: {nm} not set"
        log.info("REPLICATE %s -> %s dry_run=%s", FROM, TO, DRY)
        # Step 1: export current service
        self_env_backup = (self._env("SOLACE_COUNTRY"), self._env("SOLACE_OUTPUT_PATH"))
        tmp = Path(f"/Users/soubhik/solaceautomation/solace-automation/config/replicate-tmp-{FROM.lower()}.json")
        import os
        os.environ["SOLACE_COUNTRY"] = FROM
        os.environ["SOLACE_OUTPUT_PATH"] = str(tmp)
        export_result = self._export()
        if "ERROR" in export_result:
            return export_result
        # Step 2: clone
        os.environ["SOLACE_SOURCE_CONFIG"] = str(tmp)
        os.environ["SOLACE_FROM_COUNTRY"] = FROM
        os.environ["SOLACE_TO_COUNTRY"] = TO
        os.environ["SOLACE_DATACENTER"] = DC
        os.environ["SOLACE_OUTPUT_PATH"] = OUT
        if SN:
            os.environ["SOLACE_SERVICE_NAME"] = SN
        clone_result = self._clone()
        if "ERROR" in clone_result:
            return clone_result
        if DRY:
            return f"DRY-RUN complete\n{clone_result}"
        # Step 3: create service then provision
        cfg = json.loads(Path(OUT).read_text())
        H = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}", "Content-Type": "application/json", "Accept": "application/json"}
        S = requests.Session()
        S.headers.update(H)
        log.info("Creating service %s ...", cfg.get("service", {}).get("name", ""))
        r = S.post("https://api.solace.cloud/api/v0/services", json={"name": cfg["service"]["name"], "datacenterId": DC, "serviceTypeId": cfg["service"].get("serviceTypeId", "developer"), "serviceClassId": cfg["service"].get("serviceClassId", "developer")})
        r.raise_for_status()
        ns = r.json().get("data", {})
        nsid = ns.get("serviceId", "")
        log.info("  serviceId=%s  waiting ...", nsid)
        import time
        for _ in range(60):
            time.sleep(10)
            si = S.get(f"https://api.solace.cloud/api/v0/services/{nsid}").json().get("data", {})
            if si.get("operationStatus", "") in ("completed", "succeeded", "active"):
                break
            log.info("  state=%s", si.get("operationStatus", ""))
        nvpn = si.get("msgVpnName", "")
        cfg["service"]["serviceId"] = nsid
        cfg["clusterManagement"]["vpnName"] = nvpn
        Path(OUT).write_text(json.dumps(cfg, indent=2))
        os.environ["SOLACE_CONFIG"] = OUT
        provision_result = self._provision()
        return f"Replicate complete\n{provision_result}"
